# canvas.n3wth.com

> Live HTML/React artifact canvases. Source + running preview, public slug, Convex sync.

## For agents

Use the portable skill at `skills/canvas/SKILL.md` (also intended for skills.n3wth.com).

HTTP API on the Convex site host (`https://<deployment>.convex.site`):

- `GET /agent/v1` — discovery
- `POST /agent/v1/canvases` — create (`title?`, `kind`: `html`|`react`, `source?`)
- `GET /agent/v1/canvases` — list metadata
- `GET /agent/v1/canvases/:slug` — read source + metadata
- `PUT /agent/v1/canvases/:slug/source` — replace source (hot-updates watchers)

Auth: when `CANVAS_AGENT_TOKEN` is set on the Convex deployment, send
`Authorization: Bearer $CANVAS_AGENT_TOKEN`. Never commit the token.

Share URL shape: `https://canvas.n3wth.com/c/{slug}`

Project guidance: `AGENTS.md`

Contact: hey@n3wth.com

## Not this product

Not a whiteboard. No strokes, shapes, or freehand drawing. Not Liveblocks / Tersa / eve.dev.
